title: Problem gambling among people who bet on sports: data and code
description: Records, decisions, extracted data and analysis code for a registered systematic review and meta-analysis of the prevalence of problem gambling among people who bet on sports (search 18 October 2026; 53 studies, 58 samples, 46 samples in the meta-analyses). The repository includes the protocol and deviations log, search logs and records, two AI screening passes with the reviewer's blind calibration and decisions, the reviewer's full-text decisions, AI extraction drafts with the reviewer's verification, the analysis tables, R and Python analysis scripts, results, figures, Tables 1-4 and Supplementary Files S1-S9.
